actions.reason: C0001 has strong RNA pathway enrichment (25/50 significant, large effect sizes) and stable internal structure (median ARI 0.866, PAC 0.230). Although WXS and CNV are not significant after FDR, they show concordant trends (lower PBRM1 mutation and VHL loss) that corroborate the RNA signal. No technical confounders are significant, and known label echo is low. The evidence supports a defensible biological identity with meaningful corroboration from genomic trends.

C0002 lacks significant biological support across all modalities (no RNA pathways, no WXS or CNV after FDR). Cross-modal consistency is weak (median silhouettes near zero, low ARI 0.421, high PAC 0.811). No technical confounders explain the set, but there is no positive evidence for a distinct identity. The set is not supported by any modality, and no structural correction or resolvable evidence gap exists; therefore Drop is appropriate.

C0003 has strong RNA pathway enrichment (31/50 significant, large effect sizes) and significant CNV differences (9 features at BH-q<0.05, including lower chr20q and chr7p). The BAP1 mutation depletion trend (q=0.085) is concordant with the CNV findings. Internal structure is moderately stable (ARI 0.603, PAC 0.529). No technical confounders are significant, and known label echo is low. The RNA and CNV provide meaningful corroboration of a distinct identity.
